title: rosa glutinosa subsp. dalmatica
intro: Rosa glutinosa subsp. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa glutinosa plant, a type of fragrant rose native to Dalmatia, a region in modern-day Croatia. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dalmatian rose include its sedative and calming effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Rosa glutinosa subsp. dalmatica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
